{{Top|leg}}
'''Lager''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage, which was grouped with [[beer]] in different types of alcohol. It was popular in the underworld of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where people had less money and could not afford the more expensive beverages.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
